map.腌制盐度 = 盐用量(g) ÷（盐 + 水）总质量(g) × 100%；若按水量: Curing saltiness = salt (g) / (salt + water) total mass (g) x 100%; if counted by water alone it is salt / water x 100%, the two bases differ in value and the recipe must state which; common concentrations: vegetable pickling 3%-5%, cured meat 6%-8%, brine preservation 10%+ inhibits bacteria; salt amount = target concentration x total mass / (1 - target concentration) back-calculated.

map.盐度按总重还是水重？: Saltiness by total weight or by water weight?
map.本工具按总重（盐+水）计算，更符合腌制液实际配比；若按水重会偏高，注意区分口径。: This tool calculates by total weight (salt + water), closer to the actual brine ratio; by water weight it runs higher, so watch the basis.
map.安全盐度多少？: What is a safe salt concentration?
map.腌制保藏一般需≥3%抑制多数细菌，长期保存常取5%–10%，具体依工艺与储存条件: Curing preservation generally needs >=3% to inhibit most bacteria; long-term storage often uses 5%-10%, depending on process and storage conditions.
